risk_assessment: Core seam architecture is sound and genuinely body-fixed: exclusion AABB derives solely from the Matter grid profile (root_center_m = anchor x radius), never from the spectator; the clipper is a correct 6-plane Sutherland-Hodgman partition with outside fragments each provably outside at least one halfspace, fan triangulation winding-corrected against the source normal, and UVs sharing the exact interpolation parameter t. Sync and worker paths call the identical static clipper with identical bounds; collision is built from the exact clipped mesh in both paths; stale-cache invalidation is handled at adapter install/remove. Second-truth risk is low: bubble/adapter/presenter/clipper own no store; snapshot store, journal and mutation service are existing MW4 objects wrapped read-only; feature-off preserves snapshots. Dominant residual risks: (1) unresolved work-order path breach for terrain_streaming_manager.gd (governance, not correctness); (2) float32 quantization at lunar radius eroding the 0.02 m seam guarantee, potentially a hairline gap or marginal double-collision band at the seam - cosmetic/physics-nuisance severity, not truth corruption. Neither undermines mutation, identity, determinism, or ownership properties.
